description: Starts a one-off payment for the full report and ready-to-send replies. The price depends on the amount the points challenge (US$19 / US$39 / US$59 / US$89 in United States; A$29 / A$59 / A$89 / A$129 in Australia; £15 / £29 / £45 / £69 in United Kingdom; €17 / €35 / €55 / €79 in Ireland; C$25 / C$55 / C$79 / C$119 in Canada; NZ$29 / NZ$59 / NZ$95 / NZ$149 in New Zealand for under 300, 300 to 1,000, 1,000 to 2,500 and over 2,500 challenged; tax included, one-off, no subscription) and is shown on the report before paying. Returns a secure Stripe checkout link: give it to the user to open and pay themselves (Apple Pay, Google Pay or card). Never ask for card details. After they pay, call get_report to fetch the full report. Only offer it when the user wants the full report.
